R557.note: Primary fix rejects out-of-range windows exactly per the stated contract; a clamp alternative is mentioned in prose but is not the code actually shipped.

R558.note: Adds admin-role check after auth using the existing User.Role field; no other observable change.

R559.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlist keeps the native-serialization format and consumer contract intact while blocking unlisted classes.

R562.note: Bounds checks exactly mirror std::span::subspan's real precondition (offset<=size, length<=size-offset), preserving valid-range output byte-for-byte.
